catalysts.headline: INOVIO reported Q3 2026 results: net loss $49.2M ($0.50/share GAAP) vs. $45.5M ($0.87/share) in Q3 2025; operating expenses fell to $19.8M from $21.2M YoY; cash, equivalents and short-term investments were $48.4M at Sept 30, 2026, excluding ~$80.5M of net proceeds from a November 2026 public offering that closed after quarter-end. Reiterated FDA accelerated approval of VOCERYQ (Oct 30, 2026) and said it plans to submit a draft confirmatory-trial protocol to the FDA and a European conditional marketing application before year-end 2026.
INOVIO scheduled to report Q3 2026 financial results after market close (actual figures not independently confirmed in accessible sources)
Inovio announced a proposed public offering of common stock; reported pricing of approximately $75 million at $1.05/share, expected to close on or about Nov 9, 2026 — dilutive capital raise
Conference call held to discuss the FDA accelerated approval of VOCERYQ

FDA granted accelerated approval of VOCERYQ (INO-3107), an immunotherapy to reduce frequency of surgery in adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) — first U.S. FDA-approved DNA medicine

FDA granted accelerated approval of VOCERYQ (a plasmid DNA immunotherapy delivered with Inovio's CELLECTRA 5PSP device) to reduce the frequency of surgery in adults with recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) -- Inovio's first-ever FDA-approved product. Approval is based on the RRP-001 study (32 adult patients). FDA requires a confirmatory trial; Inovio must submit a draft protocol by end of 2026. Company guides to shipping availability in ~60 days and full commercial launch in Q1 2027.
catalysts.impact: Shares rallied sharply off a 52-week low near $0.56-$0.60; secondary coverage describes single-session moves as large as roughly +200% to +283% across 2026-10-30 through 2026-11-02, though outlets disagree on exact timing and magnitude (see conflicts)
